title: season zero m2: the hall of the fallen, a Mainframe tab and a wall in the Undercroft
why: His rulings of 11-01 (season zero m2): both a wall in the Undercroft with a portrait of each pillager in what it last wore, and a tab at the Mainframe with full stats; it keeps every pillager, forever; a pillager earns an epithet from how it plays. pilEpithet works at draw time from raids, kills, best haul and how it ended, eleven plain rules in a comment, never stored. The hall tab shows the records (longest life, richest haul, most kills, highest level), then the living one first, then every pillager newest first with how and where it ended, who killed it, generation, level, raids, best haul and kills; old records with missing fields draw what is there; generation one from an old save shows the old totals of that character, written nowhere. The wall stands in the empty bay of the back wall between the left pier and the lift housing, a station with no post and nobody beside it; a walk check from the lift still reaches every station. Its board holds the newest three in one cached canvas, baked once per hall change. R at the Mainframe opens the tab, free since the rewards key went.
now: The Mainframe has a hall tab (R, or click it): records on top, then every pillager with an epithet, and the living one first. A new wall stands left of the lift: the newest three fallen, press E there for the same tab. Watch for: a body in the Undercroft stuck near the new wall, and how the portraits read at your screen size.
